CustomField.description: Villa changes granted to THIS applicant on top of ADHA_Setting.Max_Unit_Changes__c. Set to 1 to give one person a third change. Deliberately per applicant: raising the setting instead would give everyone a third change retroactively. History tracked, so the grant records who and when. Read null-safe in Apex, since a default only applies to records created after this field.
CustomField.label: Extra Unit Changes
